_comment: Single source of truth for the 5 social-media clips. Read by both the TypeScript Higgsfield pipeline (src/clips.ts) and the open-source Wan 2.2 pipeline (local/generate_local.py). Concepts are original (no trademarked characters) and safe to publish.

clips.title: Iron Paw
clips.caption: A panda warrior holds a still stance in a misty bamboo grove.
clips.imagePrompt: cinematic 3D animated movie still, a heroic giant panda martial-arts master in a focused fighting stance, wearing a worn red sash, misty bamboo forest at golden hour, volumetric light rays, highly detailed fur, Pixar/DreamWorks style, shallow depth of field, epic, 8k
clips.motionPrompt: slow cinematic push-in, gentle drifting mist and falling bamboo leaves, subtle breathing motion, dramatic light flicker
clips.social: Meet Iron Paw 🐼🥋 Stillness before the storm. #animation #kungfu #aiart #shorts

clips.title: Neon Kaiju
clips.caption: A colossal monster rises from a neon-lit harbor at night.
clips.imagePrompt: cinematic animated film still, a colossal glowing kaiju monster emerging from the water of a futuristic neon harbor at night, reflections on wet docks, rain, city skyline silhouette, dramatic teal and magenta lighting, highly detailed, epic scale, stylized 3D animation, 8k
clips.motionPrompt: monster slowly rises, water cascades off its body, neon reflections ripple, slow upward camera tilt revealing its full height
clips.social: Something woke up in the harbor tonight 🌃🦖 #kaiju #animation #aivideo #scifi

clips.title: Sky Fox
clips.caption: An anime fox spirit leaps across moonlit rooftops.
clips.imagePrompt: anime film still, a graceful nine-tailed fox spirit with glowing blue markings mid-leap over traditional rooftops, full moon, drifting cherry blossoms, Studio-Ghibli-inspired painterly background, dynamic pose, vivid colors, high detail, cinematic lighting
clips.motionPrompt: fox leaps across the frame, tails flowing, blossoms swirling, camera pans to follow the jump, soft motion blur

clips.title: Mecha Dawn
clips.caption: A towering mecha powers up at desert sunrise.
clips.imagePrompt: cinematic animated still, a giant humanoid mecha standing in a vast desert at sunrise, panels glowing as it powers up, sand blowing across the dunes, lens flare, orange and steel color palette, mechanical detail, epic low-angle shot, stylized 3D render, 8k
clips.motionPrompt: mecha eyes light up, energy lines pulse along the armor, slow heroic low-angle push-in, sand drifting in the wind

clips.title: Crystal Dragon
clips.caption: A luminous dragon coils around a glowing crystal in an ice cavern.
clips.imagePrompt: cinematic fantasy animated still, a sleek luminous dragon coiled around a giant glowing blue crystal inside a vast ice cavern, refracted light, icy mist, intricate scales, magical glow, DreamWorks-style stylized 3D, dramatic rim lighting, high detail, 8k
